exercises.q: Отвернитесь на ___ (секунда, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **секунда → секунду** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. секунда · секунды · секунде · секунду · секундой · секунде; pl. секунды · секунд · секундам · секунды · секундами · секундах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я мало читал за ___ (последний год, acc. sg.),.
exercises.why: **год → год** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **последний → последний** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with год). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синий (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: В ___ (седьмая ночь, acc. sg.) боя на Москву опустился густой желтый туман.
